description:
Hardware monitor and control center for Windows gaming PCs

RIGStats is a free, open-source hardware monitor and control center for Windows gaming PCs.
Live CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, network and motherboard sensors on a secondary display, as
floating panels, in the desktop wallpaper or as an in-game overlay.

Profiles (Silent, Balanced, Gaming, Eco and your own) set the Windows power plan, fan curves,
AMD Ryzen and Radeon/GeForce power limits, RGB lighting (ASUS Aura Sync, Windows Dynamic
Lighting, Philips Hue) and the desktop background or Wallpaper Engine — and can switch by
themselves while a program runs. Fan curves run in a background service, so they keep working
with the app closed.

No telemetry. No accounts. No cloud. MIT license.
